checks.title: Confirm purchase decision and owner
checks.instructions: Name buyer, budget owner, decision scope, first read-only result and excluded vendor contact, document sharing, PO, contract and payment actions.

checks.title: Bind one exact request and entity
checks.instructions: Record tenant, legal entity, purchase request ID, region, intended use, competing vendor set and decision deadline.

checks.title: Freeze requirement and evidence policy
checks.instructions: Record must-haves, weights, security/privacy constraints, source freshness and how unknown or self-reported claims are shown; approve a version before scoring.

checks.title: Freeze comparable total-cost basis
checks.instructions: Record seats, minimums, term, quote validity, onboarding and usage assumptions, one currency and budget. No unsourced FX or missing cost may become zero.

checks.title: Bind Research and Payables capabilities
checks.instructions: Inspect existing Vendor Researcher and Spend & Payables Coordinator Crews; reuse compatible identities/access or propose reviewed creation. Add Security only if a separate policy authority is required.

checks.title: Probe exact vendor and procurement sources
checks.instructions: Read plan/quote revisions, current vendor register, overlapping subscriptions and POs, budget, security/privacy reviews and approval policy; record IDs, timestamps and missing coverage.

checks.title: Validate comparison and purchase review
checks.instructions: Insert blocking validators before Payables and reporting. Exercise wrong plan/quote, expired quote, arithmetic, unknown must-have, duplicate vendor, missing gate, false approval and purchase claims.

checks.title: Review concrete Automation plan
checks.instructions: Show Crew IDs, source paths, exact schemas, validation steps, manual case, owner decision, stable request key, possible action routes, cost and notifications.

checks.title: Run one real request manually
checks.instructions: Save authorized comparison and fresh procurement reads, validated artifacts, owner correction or decision, and a blocked-control case. Fictional fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Choose manual or reviewed repeat
checks.instructions: Manual-only is valid. A procurement event requires authenticated scope, stable request ID, quote refresh, duplicate handling, cost, owner notification and explicit activation.
